questions.question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Female, Doctor, Sister
questions.solution:
The relationship between the three classes: Female, Doctor, and Sister.

**Female and Sister:** All sisters are females.

Therefore, the circle representing "Sister" should be completely inside the circle representing "Female".

**Female and Doctor:** Some females are doctors, and some doctors are females.

This indicates an overlapping relationship between "Female" and "Doctor".

**Doctor and Sister:** Some sisters can be doctors, and some doctors can be sisters.

This indicates an overlapping relationship between "Doctor" and "Sister".

 

**Option 3:** Shows one circle encompassing another, and a third circle overlapping both.

This correctly represents that all sisters are females, and some females are doctors, and some sisters are also doctors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c5ce69c1ac6f1d568868e5da4f2cdb4a85aaef4a377f3dfaf54ddfd1a19b96f.png] 

Therefore, **Option 3** best illustrates the relationship.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

s t o l b _ _ _ _ o l b r _ s t _ _ _ r i
questions.solution:
The given letter series is: s t o l b _ _ _ _ o l b r _ s t _ _ _ r i

Option 1: ristiolb

If we place 'ristiolb' into the blanks:

__s t o l b __**__r i__ __s t__**__ o l b r **i**__ __s t **o l b** r i__

Based on the analysis, only Option 1, 'ristiolb', successfully completes the letter series by forming a consistent repeating pattern of "stolbri".

**Therefore, option 1 completes the series correctly.**

Option 2: tolrisb

If we place 'tolrisb' into the blanks:

s t o l b **t o l r** o l b r **i** s t **o l b** r i

This does not form a consistent or repeating pattern. 

Option 3: sirbtol

If we place 'sirbtol' into the blanks:

s t o l b **s i r b** o l b r **t** s t **o l** r i

This also does not form a consistent or repeating pattern. 

Option 4: bristol

If we place 'bristol' into the blanks:

s t o l b **b r i s** o l b r **t** s t **o l** r i

This does not result in a clear repeating pattern. 

Based on the analysis, only Option 1, 'ristiolb', successfully completes the letter series by forming a consistent repeating pattern of "stolbri".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

'A + B' means 'A is the brother of B',

'A - B' means 'A is the sister of B',

'A × B' means 'A is the mother of B' and

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B'.

How is M related to P if 'M + N - O × P ÷ Q'?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3061f41cc4ccbe69806a1869c2d4ebb341a71c0b89e83b2761c07074b96d01b8.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Sister
 Mother
 Father
 
 

 

Given: M + N - O × P ÷ Q

Let's break down the relationships step by step:

 
• **M + N**: 'M is the brother of N'. 
 
• **N - O**: 'N is the sister of O'. 
 
• **O × P**: 'O is the mother of P'. 
 
• **P ÷ Q**: 'P is the father of Q'. 

From the relationships, we can establish the following:

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cc5d8cf47518455848fcb5bd33febfb8ff4aa8d187c354ddcd460a96360fdb8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1927bebd8f4ab26372654101b2efb126960a81b0d34a4521893c0614ab140f2a.png] 

So, M is the brother of O, and O is the mother of P. This makes M the **mother's brother** of P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements :**

All beats are music.

All music are rhythms.

No rhythm is a tune.

**Conclusions :**

(I): No beat is a tune.

(II): Some rhythms are beats.
questions.solution:
Given Statements:

All beats are music.

All music are rhythms.

No rhythm is a tune.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c025b2719ea549b8c7c4831ae821918fd07fdab5d1e92680fa66e394def0906.png] 

Conclusions:

(I): No beat is a tune. → True (Since all beats are music, and all music are rhythms, it implies that all beats are also rhythms. As no rhythm is a tune, it logically follows that no beat can be a tune.) 

(II): Some rhythms are beats. → True (If all beats are part of rhythms, then it naturally follows that some rhythms must be beats)

**So,** "Both conclusions I and II follow".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
